ensures: normalize_domain_assumptions returns one closed immutable DomainAssumptionNormalizationResult with status normalized, invalid, or exhausted; ordinary malformed input and deterministic budget exhaustion never return a partial context, fact, identity, selection, or authority-bearing exception.

Before normalization the function strictly reparses and replay-validates the complete canonical reading-analysis result, embedded intake and ProblemIR chain, ambiguity topology, every candidate projection, all identities, and every frozen contract, schema, and rule-catalogue binding.

A normalized result contains exactly one candidate wrapper and one independent context for each successful MH-041 reading candidate, sorted only at the candidate-wrapper boundary by reading ID; it neither combines unresolved alternatives nor transfers any domain, variable, assumption, dependency, source span, or fact between readings.

Each context records the exact reading ID, upstream projection SHA-256, frozen rule-catalogue SHA-256, all reachable domain and variable IDs in strict stable-ID order, assumption IDs in their upstream declared set order, and one complete fact sequence whose semantic declaration order is never replaced by hash or payload sorting.

Every reachable ProblemIR domain record emits exactly one domain fact using the exact structural rule for builtin, finite, interval, modular, collection, product, function, or structure kind, retaining its complete canonical payload and declared carrier, element, bound, closure, modulus, factor, parameter, arity, and totality data without inference.

Every reachable variable emits exactly one variable-domain fact retaining its explicit domain, role, source spans, dependency closure, and exact canonical fragment; variables without a declared domain are rejected rather than assigned a default carrier.

Every declared reading assumption emits at least one exact statement-shaped fact with its given, domain_constraint, or side_condition role, origin assumption ID, statement and relation IDs where applicable, subjects, complete typed dependency closure, source spans, payload, fragment digest, reviewed rule ID, support state, and mathematical_authority false.

Only exact relation names and exact catalogued predicate identities with exact arities receive supported specialized facts. Unknown predicates and unrecognized relation, logical, or quantified structures remain visible as unsupported opaque facts rather than being dropped, guessed, rewritten, or promoted.

An exact binary not_equal relation with exactly one operand that is the exact integer or rational literal zero additionally emits the catalogued nonzero structural fact after the retained disequality fact; no simplification, arithmetic evaluation, sign inference, or other nonzero pattern is permitted.

Each fact conforms to docs/contracts/schemas/domain-assumption-fact-v1.schema.json=4d32547bc93a5bb8ddee5424eae9ce4d39c99c0f9df689db317b41dfa5e0f023 and each context conforms to docs/contracts/schemas/normalized-domain-context-v1.schema.json=066657d0b81e3589c201e1351eeb0e763f0720087864869419f5cd3317fea67e; fact, fragment, context, input, and result identities are recomputed from exact canonical bytes.

The result conforms to docs/contracts/schemas/domain-assumption-result-v1.schema.json=2f391074cfc3eae63933bcf91bb04688fddccf2b67eca6d5904edc635e9643ee, embeds the complete replay-valid successful MH-041 result, preserves its exact ambiguity and selected-reading state without choosing, and has deterministic canonical result bytes and a full lowercase SHA-256 identity.

Invalid and exhausted results contain no input identity, embedded readings result, ambiguity state, selected reading, candidate, context, fact, fragment digest, or partial authority; they contain one bounded stable diagnostic and preserve mathematical_authority false.

Strict parsing reconstructs the embedded MH-041 canonical bytes for normalized results, reruns normalize_domain_assumptions under this exact accepted contract and frozen catalogue, and requires byte-identical output; repaired outer hashes cannot legitimize fabricated, omitted, reordered, cross-reading, or surplus facts.

Exactly the eight ProblemIR domain variants map to the eight domain rules, and every builtin carrier value including boolean, natural, integer, rational, real, and complex remains exact data rather than being widened, narrowed, equated, embedded, or given inferred closure properties.

Domain and variable facts precede assumption facts; within those groups domain and variable registry IDs use stable sorted order and assumptions use declared reading order. The optional exact-zero nonzero fact immediately follows its originating disequality fact.

Known relation classification depends only on exact typed relation operators; known predicate classification depends only on exact frozen predicate identity and arity. Names, labels, summaries, string similarity, argument values, theory intuition, or external catalogs never affect classification.

Unsupported facts retain the same mandatory origin, role, statement or relation references, subjects, full dependency closure, source spans, payload, fragment digest, and ordinal as supported facts and occur exactly in unsupported_fact_sha256s in context order.

Normalized ambiguity_status, selected_reading_id, candidate membership, reading IDs, and projection hashes exactly mirror the replayed upstream result; unresolved alternatives stay separate and the function never selects, ranks, combines, or resolves them.

Failed and exhausted combinations contain no embedded upstream result, input identity, ambiguity state, selection, candidate, context, fact, fragment, or partial digest; normalized contains no diagnostics; all combinations are recomputed during strict result parsing.

Strict parsing of normalized result bytes reconstructs and strictly reparses the embedded successful MH-041 result, reruns normalize_domain_assumptions from its exact canonical bytes under this contract, and requires byte-identical output.

All strings are NUL-free NFC, integers exclude bool and remain within the portable exact range, arrays and graphs remain within fixed ceilings, duplicate JSON keys and floats fail, and subclasses, object.__new__, setattr, replace, copy, deepcopy, pickle, noncanonical encodings, and cycles cannot forge normalized state.

No default domain, undeclared assumption, equivalence, satisfiability verdict, contradiction-to-success conversion, proof obligation, solver verdict, checker attestation, certificate, proof term, or trust transition is created or preserved by this boundary.
